quests.title: Colors Out of Space

dialogue.t: Waaah, there you are, {NICKNAME}! When those two glowing things crashed into each other, the explosion sent Paimon flying! It's a good thing she didn't get hurt...
It took Paimon forever to fly back here... Paimon's just glad you're okay!

dialogue.sit: Actually, I went flying for a while too...
I think I was blown off to some strange place...

dialogue.t: Paimon under— Huh? Wait, what do you mean by flying?

dialogue.sit: You tell Paimon what you just saw...

dialogue.t: Hmm, Paimon's never heard about a place like that in Teyvat... Are you sure you weren't just seeing things, {NICKNAME}?
Anyway, as long as you're okay, that's all that matters! There's just way too much weird stuff going on around here. Let's leave this place before it's too late...
Ugh, Paimon didn't think they'd be that dangerous, and we didn't even find any treasure in the end... Why would something like that show up here, anyway?
And if those two glowing things weren't Seelies... then what were they?

quests.description: A strange phenomenon occurred in the Nothing Passage at the northern end of Lempo Isle…
